title: 第12章 炼化第13章 布置洞天
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
听着凌啸风与苏婉清一个劲地催促，凌宇默默地走进了练功室，其实他想告诉他们，自己面无血色只是法力消耗过度而已，并无什么大碍。
既然父母这么着急，连给他说话的机会都不给，他还能怎么办？也只能默默接受。
调整好心态后，凌宇开始打坐调息，恢复消耗的法力。
不到四个时辰，他就恢复了全部法力，还顺便将服用丹药后体内残留的药渣都排出了体外。
也算是彻底消除了服用大量丹药带来的隐患。
服用丹药修炼虽然效果显着，但由于炼丹师炼制手法的高低，总会有一些人体无法利用的药渣残留，若不及时炼化排出体外，可能会堵塞经脉，影响日后修炼。
好在，这些问题都已经全部解决，凌宇也将身心调整到了最佳状态，开始盘点自己这次归墟之地的收获。
凌宇自认为，这次的秘境之行收获颇丰，于是从自己的本源洞天中取出了此次的收获——两座完整的五行洞天、两座虽残缺却仍可使用的洞天，以及一件神秘宝塔。
他时常在想，为何修炼者不等到灵觉境圆满自己状态最好的时候再去归墟之地，而是刚进入灵觉境就迫不及待地前往。
在这方世界，即使不用修炼，活个三四百年也完全没有问题，再服用一些延年益寿的灵草、丹药，活个五六百年绰绰有余，时间绝对够用。
虽然不理解他们的想法，但凌宇随即也就释然了，每个人有每个人想法，尊重每个人的选择，就是尊重我们自己。
他打算先炼化神秘宝塔，看看究竟是什么宝物。
凌宇运转功法，逼出了一滴自己的精血，直接滴在了塔顶上面，然后再用法力开始炼化。
不一会儿，他便感觉自己与宝塔有了特殊的联系。
随后，他将意念投入到宝塔之上，这次没有受到任何阻挡，意念直接进入了其中。
随即一股信息也涌入凌宇的脑海，原来这座宝塔原本是一座空间属性的本源洞天。
在其主人死后，进入归墟之地，又受到空间风暴的影响，穿过空间裂缝，机缘巧合下进入了一方刚刚开始孕育的大千世界。
不知经过多少岁月，从无到有，再到大千世界成形，空间洞天也受到大千世界的影响，进化成了一方时空洞天，里面烙印了一方世界之力。
几经辗转，又回到了归墟之地，兜兜转转，直到被自己捕获。
由于时空的特殊性，塔形洞天被分为了七层，包括先天五太层、混沌层和世界层，虽然被分割成不同的层次，但却又相互影响，不分彼此。

消化完这些信息后，凌宇直接震惊了，这次真是赢麻了。
凌宇真身直接进入时空洞天，他开始小心翼翼地探查这座时空洞天。
当他进入时空洞天的时候，时空洞天也隐匿在了虚空之中。
首先是第一层的世界层，这是一个正在不断演化的世界，虽然还没有彻底完成，进化出生灵，但各种规则已经开始有序运行。
这里阴阳分判，乾坤定位，先天灵气充斥其中，循环往复。
大地广袤无垠，山脉雄伟壮观，峰顶直插云霄，云雾缭绕，宛如仙境。
森林茂密，古木参天，遮天蔽日，空气中弥漫着清新的气息，灵草灵木的香气交织在一起。
水流奔腾湍急，江河纵横交错，河水汹涌澎湃，奔腾不息，湖水则平静如镜。
虽然没有生灵，但灵花、灵草、灵药等资源丰富。
content_en:
Listening to the urging of Ling Xiaofeng and Su Wanqing, Ling Yu walked into the practice room silently. In fact, he wanted to tell them that his pale face was just an excessive consumption of mana, and there was nothing serious.
Since his parents were so worried and didn't even give him a chance to speak, what else could he do? I can only accept it silently.
After adjusting his mentality, Ling Yu began to meditate and adjust his breathing to recover the consumed mana.
In less than four hours, he had recovered all his mana and also excreted all the residue left in his body after taking the elixir.
It can be regarded as completely eliminating the hidden dangers caused by taking a large number of pills.
Although the effect of taking elixirs for practice is remarkable, due to the alchemist's refining techniques, there will always be some residue of the elixirs that cannot be used by the human body. If not refined and excreted in time, it may block the meridians and affect future cultivation.
Fortunately, all these problems have been solved, Ling Yu has also adjusted his body and mind to the best condition, and began to take stock of his gains from returning to the ruins.
Ling Yu thought that he had gained a lot from this trip to the secret realm, so he took out the harvest from his original cave - two complete Five Elements Cave, two incomplete but still usable caves, and a mysterious pagoda.
He often wonders why cultivators don't wait until the Spiritual Awareness Realm is perfected and are in the best condition before going to the Land of Return to Ruins, but instead rush there as soon as they enter the Spiritual Awareness Realm.
In this world, even if you don't need to practice, you can live for three to four hundred years without any problem. If you take some longevity-prolonging spiritual herbs and elixirs, you can live for five or six hundred years, which is more than enough time.
Although he didn't understand their thoughts, Ling Yu immediately felt relieved. Everyone has their own opinions. Respecting everyone's choice means respecting ourselves.
He planned to refine the mysterious pagoda first to see what kind of treasure it was.
Ling Yu used his skills to force out a drop of his own blood essence and dropped it directly on the top of the tower, and then used his magic power to start refining it.
After a while, he felt a special connection with the pagoda.
Then, he put his thoughts into the pagoda. This time, he was not blocked by anything and his thoughts directly entered it.
Immediately, a stream of information poured into Ling Yu's mind. It turned out that this pagoda was originally a cave with spatial attributes.
After the death of its master, he entered the Land of Return to Ruins, was affected by the space storm, passed through the space cracks, and by chance entered the vast world that had just begun to be born.
I don’t know how many years have passed, from scratch to the formation of the great world. The space cave has also been affected by the great world, and evolved into a time void sky, with the power of a world imprinted in it.
After several twists and turns, he returned to the place where he returned to the ruins, wandering around until he was captured by himself.
Due to the particularity of time and space, the tower-shaped cave is divided into seven layers, including the five innate layers, the chaos layer and the world layer. Although they are divided into different layers, they influence each other and are not differentiated from each other.
After digesting this information, Ling Yu was directly shocked. This time he really won.
Ling Yu's real body entered the space and time void directly, and he began to carefully explore the time and space.
When he entered the space of time and space, the space of space and time was also hidden in the void.
The first is the world layer of the first layer. This is a world that is constantly evolving. Although it has not yet been completely completed and evolved creatures, various rules have begun to operate in an orderly manner.
Here the yin and yang are divided, the universe is positioned, and the innate spiritual energy is filled with it, repeating the cycle.
The land is vast, the mountains are majestic, and the peaks reach into the sky, shrouded in clouds and mist, like a fairyland.
The forest is dense and the ancient trees are towering, blocking out the sky and the sun. The air is filled with fresh breath, and the aroma of spiritual grass and spiritual trees is intertwined.
The water is rushing and rushing, the rivers are criss-crossing, the rivers are turbulent and rushing, but the lake water is as calm as a mirror.
Although there are no living beings, there are spiritual flowers, spiritual herbs, and spiritual medicines.Resources are abundant.
